vectors.note: digest checked by report vectors against pinned goldens
digest checked by report vectors against pinned goldens
exact closed set, no more no fewer
counterpart must carry the full match tuple
recomputed base report validates end to end
join-contract turn with attempt/receipt refs and identity
complete receipt identity plus payload binding
ledger record with registry id key
chain-link semantics are checked across report receipts

semantic_notes.text: Ed25519 over domain || 0x00 || canonical(full record minus signature and signed_digest); every single-field mutation changes the payload digest, so a copied signature cannot verify. Covered executably by check_d3_stagec_signatures.py (mutation, replay, key-list, validity, use-constraint cases).

Each metric formula is pinned text plus a golden digest; the validator rebuilds the digest from the text and requires an exact metric-id set match, so removal, addition, or change of any formula is rejected.

Report-checker inputs are schema-valid source/join records (caseTurn/caseAttempt/caseReceipt/captureEvent per the registry): the checker schema-gates every case before recompute, and the R1 join verifies run-set, order/index, activity, and payload identity with duplicate-ID rejection.

CAPTURE_HEALTH is a COUNT metric whose numerator is the sum of the five capture-health counters; the validator recomputes the counters from capture events plus receipt flags and turn markers and requires the metric, the report capture block, and the recomputed total to agree exactly.

Every report case carries the freeze its report is bound to: the validator schema-gates the freeze, recomputes its self-hash, and requires the report freeze_hash to equal that digest with a matching run set, so a report recomputed for a different freeze voids.

Every control record carries its shadow counterpart: the validator recomputes the MATCHED/MISMATCH/UNMATCHED label from the tuple comparison via compare_pair — including agreement of both control_order values — and requires the stored label to agree, so a MATCHED label on divergent, order-disagreeing, or missing counterpart evidence voids.
The reconciled attempt-ledger total must not exceed the freeze's total_reservations_max: the validator binds its total check to the frozen limit, so a consistent report over the cap voids.
